item.title: Woman, child killed in central Toledo house fire
item.description: A woman and a young child have died following a fire at a central city home Thursday afternoon.

item.title: Second of 4 men charged in teen’s murder pleads to manslaughter
item.description: A second of four men charged with aggravated murder for a 16-year-old’s shooting death a year ago in North Toledo pleaded guilty Thursday morning to involuntary manslaughter and robbery.

item.title: Women’s Day luncheon to examine workplace, caregiving systems
item.description: For the first time, Women of Toledo’s International Women’s Day luncheon is inviting men to the conversation, making clear that fixing caregiving and workplace systems is everyone’s job.

item.title: Ohio Gov. DeWine signs tax conformity bill
item.description: COLUMBUS — Gov. Mike DeWine on Thursday signed tax conformity legislation Senate Bill 9, which aims to simplify the tax filing process for Ohio businesses and individuals.

item.title: Trump says he wants to be involved in picking Iran's next leader as war ripples across the region
item.description: DUBAI, United Arab Emirates — U.S. President Donald Trump said Thursday he should be involved in choosing Iran’s next supreme leader as the U.S. and Israel hammered the country for a sixth day. Iran kept up retaliatory attacks on Israel, American bases and countries around the region.

item.title: Darrington's 46-point night leads Glass City Wranglers past Columbus
item.description: Chris Darrington scored 46 points as the Glass City Wranglers defeated the Columbus Wizards 113-107 in a game in the Basketball League on Thursday at the Glass City Center.

item.title: High school boys basketball: Southview gets by Wapakoneta in Division III district semifinal
item.description: FINDLAY — Southview withstood a furious fourth-quarter rally by Wapakoneta as the Cougars held on for a 47-45 victory in a Division III, Northwest 1 district semifinal at Liberty-Benton on Thursday.

item.title: High school girls basketball: Patrick Henry tops Columbus Grove in Division VI regional semifinal
item.description: BLUFFTON, Ohio — Patrick Henry punched its ticket to the Division VI regional final with a 48-41 victory Columbus Grove at Bluffton University on Thursday.

item.title: Cole Porvaznik's hat trick fuels St. Francis hockey; Northview awaits in regional final
item.description: BOWLING GREEN — St. Francis de Sales jumped all over Clay in the first period of a regional hockey semifinal and never let up on Thursday night as the Knights used a smothering offensive attack to roll to a 10-0 shutout.

item.title: Wembanyama has 38 points and 16 rebounds in the Spurs' 121-106 win over the Pistons
item.description: SAN ANTONIO — Victor Wembanyama had 38 points, 16 rebounds and five blocks and the San Antonio Spurs never trailed in completing a sweep of Detroit, beating the Pistons 121-106 on Thursday night.
